summary: Dependency sourced from unpinned GitHub HEAD executes at install time
details: @kelvdra/baileys@1.0.6-rc.5 declares its `libsignal` dependency as `github:Kelvdra/libsignal` with no commit SHA, tag, or version pin. On `npm install`, the dependency is resolved from the current HEAD of the author-controlled GitHub repository and any lifecycle scripts in whatever that repo returns are executed, with no integrity check and no registry review. The content fetched can change at any time after this package is published, so installing this version does not pin the code that actually runs. The package is a fork of Baileys (a WhatsApp Web library); a separate static match on lib/Utils/generics.js references a `ping` token near HTTP GET usage, consistent with the upstream library's connectivity/keepalive handling rather than a confirmed exfiltration path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
